# Petfolioo — Full Documentation for AI Crawlers

> Complete pet health management platform for modern pet parents and professional breeders.

Petfolioo is a mobile-first platform (iOS and Android) that provides digital pet health management including vaccination tracking, health records, pregnancy monitoring, breeding marketplace, care scheduling, and health reports. Founded in 2024 and headquartered in Helsingborg, Sweden.

## Core Features

### Vaccination Tracker
Log vaccines with dates, types, batch numbers, and administering veterinarian. Smart reminders notify owners before vaccinations are due. Species-specific schedules distinguish between core and non-core vaccines. Supports dogs, cats, birds, rabbits, reptiles, fish, horses, and other species. Generates digital vaccination certificates that can be shared with boarding facilities, travel authorities, or other veterinarians.

### Health Records
Digital records for vet visits, surgeries, medications, weight measurements, lab results, and clinical notes. Secure cloud storage with encryption at rest and in transit. PDF report generation for vet visits, travel documents, breed registration, and insurance claims. Records are accessible from any device and shareable via secure links.

### Pregnancy Monitor
Week-by-week milestones for dogs (63 days), cats (65 days), and other species with species-specific timelines. Tracks expected delivery dates, weight changes, ultrasound results, veterinary checkups, and behavioral changes. Supports multiple concurrent pregnancies for professional breeders. Maintains complete breeding history per animal.

### Mating Marketplace
Connect verified pet owners and breeders looking for breeding partners. Every listing includes health certifications, breed verification, lineage information, and location data. Direct messaging between owners for discussing terms and sharing documents. Verification badges for registered breeders maintaining health standards. Designed for responsible breeding with emphasis on genetic diversity.

### Smart Schedules
Feeding, medication, grooming, exercise, and flea/tick treatment reminders. Customized per pet species, breed, and age. Recurring reminders with configurable intervals. Unified calendar view for multi-pet households.

### Health Reports
Professional PDF reports including vaccination history, medical records, weight logs, and health notes. Suitable for veterinary visits, international pet travel, breed registration bodies, insurance claims, and boarding facilities. Follows clinical documentation standards with chronological entries.

## Supported Species

- Dogs: All breeds including mixed breeds. Breed-specific health insights, vaccination schedules per WSAVA guidelines.
- Cats: Indoor and outdoor profiles. Breed-specific risks and vaccination protocols.
- Birds: Parrots, canaries, finches. Avian-specific health tracking.
- Rabbits: Vaccination (myxomatosis, RHD), dental health tracking.
- Hamsters, Guinea Pigs: Lifespan-appropriate health milestones.
- Reptiles: Snakes, lizards, turtles. Shedding cycles, UV exposure tracking.
- Fish: Tank parameters, disease logging, species compatibility.
- Horses: Equine vaccination schedules, farrier appointments, competition health certificates.

## For Pet Owners
Track health, vaccinations, and schedules for personal pets. Free plan supports up to 3 pets with full feature access. Multi-pet household management with unified calendar. Family sharing for multiple caregivers.

## For Professional Breeders
Full pregnancy management with week-by-week milestones. Lineage documentation and breeding history. Mating marketplace access. Health certification exports for breed registration bodies. Multi-litter management with individual offspring tracking. Integration with Swedish Kennel Club (SKK) standards.

## For Veterinarians
Access patient health histories shared by pet owners. Issue digital vaccination certificates. Structured intake data reduces consultation time. Verification badge establishes professional trust. Supports WSAVA vaccination guidelines and Nordic veterinary standards.

## For Pet Shops
Set up digital health profiles at point of sale. Include initial vaccinations, deworming, and health checks. Automated care reminders drive customer retention. Partner verification badge on the platform. Local services directory listing.

## For Shelters and Rescue Organizations
Document rescue animal health from intake to adoption. Seamless record transfer from shelter to adopter. Multi-animal management for organizations of any size. Free shelter accounts with unlimited profiles. Integration with Swedish animal welfare regulations.

## Technical Details

- Platform: Mobile (Flutter/Dart) on iOS and Android
- Backend: REST API (Fastify/TypeScript) hosted on Google Cloud Run
- Database: Firebase Firestore (EU region, europe-north1, Finland)
- Authentication: Firebase Auth (Google Sign-In, Apple Sign-In, Email/Password)
- Storage: Google Cloud Storage for images and documents
- Languages: English, Swedish (Norwegian, Danish, Finnish planned)
- Data Region: EU (europe-north1, Finland)
- Compliance: GDPR compliant, encrypted at rest and in transit
- Uptime: 99.9% SLA via Google Cloud Run managed platform

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What is Petfolioo?
A: Petfolioo is a comprehensive pet health management platform available as a mobile app on Android and iOS. It helps pet owners track vaccinations, manage health records, monitor pregnancies, set care schedules, and find breeding partners. Founded in Sweden, it serves the Nordic market with plans for EU expansion.

Q: How much does Petfolioo cost?
A: Petfolioo offers a free tier supporting up to 3 pets with full access to health records, vaccination tracking, and scheduling. Premium subscriptions unlock unlimited pets, breeding marketplace access, advanced health reports, and priority support.

Q: What species does Petfolioo support?
A: Dogs, cats, birds (parrots, canaries, finches), rabbits, hamsters, guinea pigs, reptiles (snakes, lizards, turtles), fish, and horses. Each species has customized health tracking, vaccination schedules, and care milestones.

Q: Is Petfolioo GDPR compliant?
A: Yes. All data is stored in the EU (europe-north1 region, Finland), encrypted at rest and in transit. Users have full data export and deletion capabilities. Authentication uses Firebase Auth with support for Google, Apple, and email sign-in.

Q: Where is Petfolioo available?
A: Petfolioo is available worldwide via Google Play and the Apple App Store, but is specifically designed for the Nordic market (Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland). The app supports English and Swedish, with additional Nordic languages planned.

Q: Can I share records with my vet?
A: Yes. Generate PDF health reports or share digital access via secure links. Verified veterinarians can view shared records and issue digital vaccination certificates.

## Technical Details

- Platform: Mobile-first (Flutter/Dart for iOS and Android), Web (Next.js)
- Backend: Node.js/Fastify on Google Cloud Run
- Database: Google Cloud Firestore (NoSQL)
- Storage: Google Cloud Storage (media, documents)
- Auth: Firebase Authentication (Google, Apple, Email)
- Hosting: EU region (europe-north1, Finland)
- API: RESTful with OpenAPI documentation at https://api.petfolioo.com/api/v1/docs
